title: A masked edit shows the model only the mask box, so it cannot keep what is outside it
description: Proven from the dispatched graph and the pixels, 2026-09-22 (Fabio's MPI-877 round-2 run, ComfyUI /history). On a masked edit the model is shown the CROP and nothing else: `Input_Mask` (node 296, output 4) drives an `MpiIfElse` (592) that forwards `InpaintCropImproved`'s crop instead of `Input_Image`, and `context_from_mask_extend_factor: 1.0` makes that crop the mask bounding box, resized to 1024x1024 before the VAE encode. Measured here: bbox 257x257 at (264,683) of a 768x1024 card. Extracting that region from the card shows it holds the boy's WHOLE reflection - head, hair, white shirt, rod, upside down. The model had the reflected boy. What it did NOT have is the rest of the frame: the boy himself on the bank, the bank, the orientation of the scene. Given a square of water with an inverted figure in it and no idea that figure is a mirror image, it rendered an UPRIGHT demon rising out of the water and drew its own reflection beneath it. Fabio: 'a demon face that has got nothing to do with the boy'. So the failure is the crop losing the RELATIONSHIP, not losing the subject. Not agent-specific: the Cue path in the History workspace injects the same `Input_Mask` into the same graph, so a hand-painted masked edit has always been cropped this way. Two candidate directions, Fabio's call: raise `context_from_mask_extend_factor` above 1.0 so the crop carries the surrounding frame (cheap, affects every masked op on every master graph), or feed the WHOLE picture into a free reference slot on the models that have one (kleinEdit takes three images and injection is ordinal - MPI-877 deliberately left those slots alone). Needs a real render to judge, not a spec. Split out of MPI-877, which fixed only where the edit LANDS and which picture the mask binds to.
